description: macos/core tests allowed to exceed the 20 s per-test limit that scripts/core-test-time-guard.py enforces after the Mac core test shards. Each entry is Class/method with a written reason and its own cap in seconds, about 1.5 times its measured time; a run over its cap fails like any other slow test. This file is meant to shrink over time: remove an entry once its test is fast. Adding an entry or raising a cap must be a visible change that a reviewer approves on its own merits, never a quiet way to make CI pass. nightly_total_cap_seconds is the summed per-test time of the whole suite above which the nightly run prints a warning; it never fails.
source: Per-test durations from the latest full main run on 2026-11-24 (suite total about 7,974 s). Each cap is about 1.5 times the measured time, rounded up.
